The '''Esh-kha Tactical Center''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vault located in the [[Warlord's Deep]] in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] took over the vault and converted it into a tactical command center.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Esh-kha Tactical Center appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] mission "Ancient Transmissions."<ref name="TOR" />
